# Kensington Asset Management Captures Third Consecutive PSN Top Guns Award, Reinforcing Strategy Momentum. ***For the third consecutive quarter, Kensington Asset Management, LLC's Dynamic Allocation Strategy has been named to the PSN Top Guns List of best performing separate accounts, managed accounts, and managed ETF strategies.***. **AUSTIN, Texas, November 25, 2025 (Newswire.com) -** For the third consecutive quarter, Kensington Asset Management, LLC's Dynamic Allocation Strategy has been named to the *PSN Top Guns List* of best performing separate accounts, managed accounts, and managed ETF strategies. The Strategy earned recognition across five categories in the Q3 2025 results, including both quarterly and one-year rankings. Published by Zephyr, the PSN Top Guns List remains one of the most widely referenced performance screens in the asset-management industry. * 1 Quarter - ETF US Equity Universe. * 1-Year - ETF US Equity Universe. "We're grateful to see our Dynamic Allocation Strategy continue to be recognized for its performance for a third quarter in a row," said Jason Sim, Portfolio Manager at Kensington Asset Management, LLC.

# Quarterly rankings identify best-in-class separate accounts, managed accounts and managed ETF strategies. The PSN Top Guns award has been a hallmark of excellence in the managed account industry for over 20 years. ***Zephyr Releases PSN Top Guns List for Q1 2026, Highlighting Best-In-Class Separate Accounts, Managed Accounts and Managed ETF Strategies***. ***Zephyr Releases PSN Top Guns Manager of the Decade for 2025, Highlighting Best-In-Class Separate Accounts, Managed Accounts and Managed ETF Strategies over a 10-year period.***. BOCA RATON, Fla., Dec. 12, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Financial Trust Asset Management announced today it has been named to the celebrated PSN Top Guns List of best performing separate accounts, managed accounts, and managed ETF strategies for Q3 2025. **AMG Capital Management’s (ACM) Small and Mid Cap Portfolio Strategy** has been named to the celebrated PSN Top Guns List of best performing separate accounts, managed accounts, and managed ETF strategies for Q4 2024, including Manager of the Decade in the Small-Mid Value Universe.
